statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is determined as follows. Define a square streak of length L in nums, for L >= 2, to mean that there exist integers x_0, ..., x_{L-1} such that each x_t occurs in nums (there is an index i with nums[i] = x_t) and x_t = x_{t-1} * x_{t-1} for every t with 1 <= t < L. If no L >= 2 admits a square streak of length L in nums, then r = -1. Otherwise r is the largest L >= 2 such that nums contains a square streak of length L; equivalently, if r >= 2 then nums contains a square streak of length r and every square streak in nums has length at most r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail, panic, overflow, or access an out-of-bounds index.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1 or 2 <= r <= 5.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 2, we have r <= len(nums).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 2, there exist integers x_0, ..., x_{r-1} such that each x_t occurs in nums and x_t = x_{t-1} * x_{t-1} for every t with 1 <= t < r; that is, nums contains a square streak of length r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 2, every square streak in nums has length at most r. Here a square streak of length L in nums, for L >= 2, means there exist x_0, ..., x_{L-1}, each occurring in nums, with x_t = x_{t-1} * x_{t-1} for every t with 1 <= t < L.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = -1 if and only if there do not exist two distinct indices i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), and nums[j] = nums[i] * nums[i].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r >= 2, for every L with 2 <= L <= r, nums contains a square streak of length L (values x_0, ..., x_{L-1} occurring in nums with x_t = x_{t-1} * x_{t-1} for 1 <= t < L).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 5 if and only if the five values 2, 4, 16, 256, and 65536 each occur in nums.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 2 if nums[0] * nums[0] = nums[1] or nums[1] * nums[1] = nums[0]; otherwise r = -1.
preconditions: len(nums) = 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 2 <= nums[i] <= 100000.

statement: For any two such arrays nums1 and nums2, if for every integer v, v occurs in nums1 if and only if v occurs in nums2, then whenever the function returns r1 on nums1 and r2 on nums2, we have r1 = r2.
preconditions: nums1 and nums2 each satisfy len >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), 2 <= nums1[i] <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums2), 2 <= nums2[i] <= 100000.

statement: For any two such arrays nums1 and nums2, if every value that occurs in nums1 also occurs in nums2, then whenever the function returns r1 on nums1 and r2 on nums2, either r1 = -1 or (r2 >= 2 and r2 >= r1).
preconditions: nums1 and nums2 each satisfy len >= 2; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums1), 2 <= nums1[i] <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums2), 2 <= nums2[i] <= 100000.
